snippet.title: Dark Mass - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A Gameplay trailer for Dark Mass. Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
